{{Quote|Commander, the communications blanket has gone offline.|The man, to Pyre|audio=FirstOrderMan-Descent.flac|<ref name="Descent" />}}
A '''man'''<ref name="Subtitles" /> was affiliated with the [[First Order]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Descent" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|19}}</ref> after the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|refueling station]] was [[Mission to contact the Resistance|sunk]] into the [[ocean]] of<ref name="Descent" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}}</ref> [[Castilon]] by the [[Resistance]] members [[Jarek Yeager]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]], the First Order [[Gender|man]] informed [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] and [[First Order Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] that the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station's]] communications blanket had gone offline as a result of its sinking. In response, [[Imanuel Doza]]—the [[Space station|station's]] [[captain]] who had secretly been working with the Resistance operatives—claimed that the communications blanket must have gone down as a result of [[water]] damage. Afterward, Tieny looked outside of [[Doza's office]]'s [[Viewport|window]] and noted that the blanket was still above sea level, prompting Pyre to leave the office with [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] to investigate.<ref name="Descent" />

==Behind the scenes==
The man appeared, albeit only through voice, in "[[Descent (episode)|Descent]],"<ref name="Descent" /> the eighteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',<ref name="Insider" /> which aired on [[March 3]], [[2019]].<ref name="Air date">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> Their voice actor was uncredited in the episode.<ref name="Descent" />
